candidate.name: Muhammad Rayyan Ahmed
credentials: M.Sc. Data Science (in progress), TU Ilmenau

letter.opening: I am applying for the Working Student position as Safety Data Analyst. Turning operational data into clear reports for decision-makers is what I did in my previous roles, and safety data is a field where getting the numbers right really matters.
letter.profile_intro: I am an M.Sc. Data Science student at TU Ilmenau with a B.S. in Artificial Intelligence. I worked as a Business Analyst at Tapal Tea and in SAP data and analytics at TallyMarks Consulting.

achievements.impact: I built quality inspection and expense dashboards in SAP Analytics Cloud and supported around 30 dashboards across HR, finance and supply chain
I used SQL analysis, validation and reconciliation to make sure reported numbers were correct
I collected requirements from business users and documented sources, calculations and results for every dashboard I built

letter.problems_section: I would analyse safety data, build clear reports, support project coordination and use Microsoft 365 confidently. My Power BI is basic, but I have built many dashboards in SAP Analytics Cloud and expect to get up to speed quickly.
letter.closing: I am willing to relocate to Hamburg and can work up to 20 hours per week, starting immediately. I would be glad to discuss the role.
letter.language_closing: I work in English (IELTS 8.0) and am currently learning German (A1).
